title.narrative: Belize Energy Resilience for Climate Adaptation (GEF/SCCF)

description.narrative: The development objective of the proposed Energy Resilience for Climate Adaptation Project is to demonstrate solutions that enhancethe resilience of the energy system to adverse weather and climate change impacts. This will be collectively achieved by implementing a wide-ranging and complementary set of activities that include pilot initiatives, infrastructure hardening, and analytical and planning efforts.

title.narrative: Electricity consumers with enhanced security of electricity supply (reduced outages) despite weather events, of which, those are women
Consumers with enhanced security of electricity supply (reduced outages) due to weather events
Weak transmission sections in the system reinforced to be more resilient
Regional stakeholder and citizen engagement conferences held to evaluate and disseminate lessons learned and results achieved in project for enhancing energy resilience
Weather monitoring stations are installed and functioning
Training sessions on energy sector long-term planning conducted
Generation sources available for dispatch despite line faults
Generation capacity available for dispatch despite line faults
Appropriate technologies identified to be used for transmission line design for different terrain types
Methodologies and procedures to incorporate climate resilience in long-term planning of energy infrastructure and systems developedand adopted
Transmission network segmented and protected against cascading line faults
Vegetable management plan for transmission and distribution lines informed with industry good practice
Comprehensive emergency preparedness and recovery plan adopted
